# ffxf_role (Resource)

Manages a role: a named set of policies that API keys and OIDC bindings act through. A credential cannot modify a role it holds or can assume, and a role still used by a key or binding cannot be deleted or emptied.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_role" "readers" {
  name        = "readers"
  description = "Can read virtual machines"
  policy_ids  = [ffxf_policy.readers.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, unique per account, up to 80 characters.
- `policy_ids` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the policies the role carries, yours or provided ones, at most 10.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description, up to 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Role identifier.
